briefing: Elite: Ash-Court Betrayal: Threshold Sign. Infernal Dominion advances through ash-court gallery where bargain traps split risk from reward while the Gate tests whether power belongs to those capable of wielding it.

missionIntro.speaker: Infernal Dominion Titan Voice
missionIntro.text: The field asks for proof. Five Titans enter, and The Cinder-Wound Gate will remember how we answer.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge to test Cinders of Dominion: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Infernal Dominion Titan Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Infernal Dominion Titan Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: This mission keeps Infernal Dominion doctrine intact: They can weaponize catastrophe better than any Realm, but every alliance with them asks who will hold the chain afterward.
